sample.note: Exploratory single-model pilot. N=1 regret-positive case (educational_intervention_g, regret=980875). All intervals are extremely wide. Sensitivity = 100% at all thresholds, but PPV = 0.5 at threshold >=3.

headline.claim: A blinded epistemic-gap rating showed 100% sensitivity but PPV=0.5 at threshold >=3. Regret rate was 20% (2/10). The single regret-positive case cannot establish predictive validity.

contrasting_cases.note: N=1 regret-positive case. Zero gap but highest regret. Drives sensitivity=100% at thresholds but PPV=0.5.

critical_limitation: N=1 regret-positive case. With only one scenario exhibiting regret, all sensitivity and PPV estimates have extreme uncertainty. Sensitivity=100% (TP=1, FP=4) but PPV=0.2 overall, 0.5 at threshold >=3. Cannot establish predictive validity.
